# ENGLISH MASTER

> ENGLISH MASTER is an online English-learning platform focused on CEFR and IELTS preparation.

## Main website

- [ENGLISH MASTER homepage](https://english-master-aow.pages.dev/): Public entry point for the learning platform.
- [Platform features](https://english-master-aow.pages.dev/#features): Overview of learning and practice features.
- [About ENGLISH MASTER](https://english-master-aow.pages.dev/#about): Platform information.

## Learning features

- CEFR and IELTS preparation information.
- Reading practice and an introductory reading assessment.
- English vocabulary practice.
- AI-assisted English conversation practice.
- Speaking practice interface.

## Important notes

- Assessment results shown by the website are learning estimates, not official CEFR or IELTS certificates.
- Some learning features require signing in with a Google account.
- Do not assume that every planned feature is currently available.
